map.作物轮作周期规划表 使用指南: Crop Rotation Cycle Planner User Guide
map.基于\"豆科 → 禾本科 → 叶菜类 → 根茎类\"循环原理，选择种植面积和起始: Based on the "legume -> cereal -> leafy vegetable -> root and tuber" cycle, choose the planting area and the starting season to generate a 4-year rotation plan automatically, labelling each season's crop and the reason for the rotation.
map.多数土传病害有专一寄主。寄主停种 1~2 年后土壤中病原菌因缺食衰减，下茬再种时: Most soil-borne diseases have a specific host. After the host is not grown for 1~2 years, the pathogen in the soil decays for lack of food, so the next crop faces a low baseline and milder disease.
map.按科属、需肥特性、病虫寄主安排 2~4 年轮作顺序。: Arrange a 2~4 year rotation by plant family, fertilizer demand and pest hosts.
map.用于减轻连作障碍、均衡地力。: Used to reduce continuous-cropping obstacles and balance soil fertility.
map.豆科养地、禾本科耗地、块根类深松交替。: Legumes build soil, cereals draw it down, and deep-rooted tubers loosen the soil in rotation.
map.豆科固氮后土壤速效氮较高，禾本科需氮多正好利用；且两者科属不同、病虫不交叉，是经: After legumes fix nitrogen the soil has plenty of available nitrogen, which is exactly what nitrogen-hungry cereals need; the two also belong to different families so pests and disease do not carry over. This is the classic "feed and use" combination.
map.：第 1 年玉米（禾本科、耗氮）→ 第 2 年大豆（豆科、固氮养地）→ 第 3: : year 1 maize (cereal, nitrogen-demanding) -> year 2 soybean (legume, fixes nitrogen and builds soil) -> year 3 potato (tuber, deep roots loosen the soil and avoid diseases of the same family). After three years maize returns, and both soil fertility and disease pressure are clearly better than under continuous cropping.
